semantics.identity_rule: Each fault profile has an explicit identity.
semantics.sandbox_rule: Fault injection defaults to verification/sandbox scope unless production experiment is explicitly governed.
semantics.evidence_rule: Injected fault is tagged so observed failure can be distinguished from spontaneous failure.
semantics.authority_rule: Fault injection requires exact applicable test/admin authority.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: fault injector targets all services by wildcard accidentally
production fault enabled by test default
injected failure indistinguishable from real incident

references.purpose: Fault injection verifies explicit degraded/failure behavior.
